title: ZIA China Premium and Premium Plus Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) China Premium and ZIA China Premium Plus are Software as a Service (SaaS) products that are licensed according to the bandwidth purchased for the subscription term in an order. To learn more, see Managing ZIA Use in China.

For ZIA China Premium, bandwidth is defined as the amount of data that is transmitted over a network connection and processed by ZIA within a Premium data center operated by Zscaler in China. Bandwidth is calculated in Megabits per second (Mbps) using five-minute samples. Zscaler calculates bandwidth based on Received (Rx) and Transmitted (Tx) Mbps. All five-minute samples from a data center in a calendar month are sorted, and the 95th percentile value is taken (P95 Accounting Method). This calculation is done separately for both the Tx and Rx values. The larger of the two is used as that data center's bandwidth usage. The P95 Accounting Method is calculated for each Premium data center accessed each month. The P95 Accounting Method bandwidth usage values from all Premium data centers are combined (summed) in order to compute the total bandwidth usage for that calendar month.

You must remain within your purchased bandwidth for 95% of the time in any calendar month. By calculating monthly bandwidth usage at the 95th percentile, you can burst above your purchased bandwidth for up to 5% of the month without incurring additional charges. In a 30-day calendar month, this represents approximately 36 hours.

Ensure that you order the correct amount of bandwidth. If you require additional bandwidth, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. If you exceed your total purchased bandwidth, you shall promptly reduce your bandwidth usage until it is within the purchased bandwidth amount or place an order for additional bandwidth. Zscaler periodically reviews bandwidth usage to ensure license compliance.
In order to protect the ZIA China Premium quality of service, Zscaler reserves the right to deploy bandwidth control policies to restrict bandwidth consumption to within purchased bandwidth.

When calculating bandwidth consumption, in addition to internal tools, Zscaler may use reports from 3rd-party network and internet service providers. Upon written request, Zscaler will provide bandwidth usage reports for the previous calendar month.

Your use of ZIA China Premium is subject to the terms of Zscaler's Supplemental Premium China Services Availability Agreement. The Service Availability Agreement will not apply if you exceed the burst limits (greater than 130% at any time and/or greater than 5% of five-minute samples in a calendar month).

The maximum burst bandwidth may not exceed 130% of the purchased bandwidth at any time. Excess bursting bandwidth (whether excess in time or in bandwidth) is only available on a best-effort basis and may be subject to throttling down to your purchased bandwidth.

For ZIA China Premium Plus, bandwidth is defined as the amount of data that is transmitted over a network connection and processed by ZIA within a Premium Plus data center operated by Zscaler in China. Bandwidth is calculated in Megabits per second (Mbps) using five-minute samples. Zscaler calculates bandwidth based on Received (Rx) and Transmitted (Tx) Mbps. All five-minute samples from a data center in a calendar month are sorted, and the highest value is taken (Peak Accounting Method). This calculation is done separately for both the Tx and Rx values. The larger of the two is used as that data center's bandwidth usage. The Peak Accounting Method is calculated for each Premium Plus data center accessed each month. The Peak Accounting Method bandwidth usage values from all Premium Plus data centers are combined (summed) in order to compute the total bandwidth usage for that calendar month. The bursting limitations applicable to ZIA China Premium do not apply to ZIA China Premium Plus.

Ensure that you order the correct amount of bandwidth. If you require additional bandwidth, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. If you exceed your total purchased bandwidth, you shall promptly reduce your bandwidth usage until it is within the purchased bandwidth amount or place an order for additional bandwidth. Zscaler periodically reviews bandwidth usage to ensure license compliance.
In order to protect the ZIA China Premium Plus quality of service, Zscaler reserves the right to deploy bandwidth control policies to restrict bandwidth consumption to within purchased bandwidth.

When calculating bandwidth consumption, in addition to internal tools, Zscaler may use reports from 3rd-party network and internet service providers. Upon written request, Zscaler will provide bandwidth usage reports for the previous calendar month.
Your use of ZIA China Premium Plus is subject to the terms of Zscaler's Supplemental Premium China Services Availability Agreement.
The usage of ZIA China Premium Plus is expected to be in accordance with the Acceptable Use Policy.
